title: selliguea ceratophylla
intro: Selliguea ceratophylla, commonly known as the "Wild Ginger", is a type of plant species in the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea ceratophylla include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
